notes: Ratings are Glicko-2. Base is folkstyle competition tracked on carank.neocities.org. Freestyle is folded in as a post-season rating period at 0.65 style weight: the 2026 CAUSAW state event (85 both-on-board bouts) and Fargo 2026 CA-vs-CA bouts (11 bouts, 9 wrestlers). Junior and 16U boys freestyle only; no Greco. Junior National Duals and Kids Nationals contributed 0 bouts (structural). The 'Record' column is TRACKED head-to-head only: it counts bouts ingested from the sources above, not a wrestler's full season record. A wrestler's real record is almost always better than what this column shows. Rank order is not strictly monotonic with rating on every board, because folkstyle head-to-head tiebreaks are preserved for wrestlers who did not compete in freestyle. 691 Fargo CA-vs-out-of-state bouts are EXCLUDED: no validated rating exists for out-of-state opponents, and estimating one would be a guess. Wrestlers who competed in summer freestyle are therefore evaluated on more evidence than those who did not, and carry tighter rating deviations (rd) as a result. This is a property of the data available, not a judgment about wrestlers who did not compete in the summer. Graduated seniors are filtered at build time. Girls board entries carry no grade data, so graduated girls may remain listed until early-season results identify them. METHOD (Sept 2026): board order is derived from Glicko-2 rating, not inherited from the upstream carank published order; carank remains a data source for results, grade and team only. Glicko-2 weights each bout by margin of victory: ln(mov+1) with decision=1, major decision=2, tech fall=3, fall=3 (a tech fall and a pin weigh the same), damped by the rating gap so a heavy favourite gains less for a one-sided win, then normalised to mean bout weight 1.0. Head-to-head is graded rather than absolute: a win reorders the pair when the rating gap is within that result type allowance - decision 50, major decision 100, tech fall or fall 175 - so a close win over a much stronger wrestler earns full rating credit without by itself reversing the order. Wrestler names previously carried carank ranking prefixes (HM, -) in the name field; these are now stripped and recorded in a separate tier field. CA Super 32 Early Entry (Gilroy, 09/05-09/06/2026) folded in at 1.0 style weight; competed weight not used for board placement; record column includes these results.
watch_notes: Tournament entrants not on any board, with RD below 200. Rated from a 1500/350 prior over the tournament data in tournaments/; not comparable to board ratings. competed_weight is the weight wrestled, not a board placement. An entrant joins the board (provisional) the first time he or she beats a board wrestler in a contested bout at a varsity event.
